Priya: Daypulse pulse — quick kernel / batching / KV cache check-in.
Priya: Yesterday: shipped prefetch backpressure fix to canary, ran a couple kv-warmup benches against rtx-prod pool.
Priya: Blocker: when prefetch rate > 600 req/s, seeing 5-10% p99 latency spikes; couldn't repro on my dev rig.
Alex: I hit that on canary too — left a short log dump in /mnt/logs/prefetch/canary-1753.log (TL;DR: burst + eviction churn).
Alex: snippet from the canary log:
```
[2026-03-12T09:12:03Z] prefetcher: rate=650 p99=124ms cache_hit=0.82
[2026-03-12T09:12:04Z] prefetcher: evict=12 slot_stall=true
```
Sam: I opened a tiny micropatch to clamp the prefetch window (PR #523) — caps to 512 tokens when concurrent inflight > 400. Needs review.
Jon: glanced at #523, left a few nits around metrics naming and added a unit test suggestion for the eviction path.
Dana: ran the staging perf sweep after Sam's patch. Numbers: baseline throughput ~0.78 tokens/ms, patch => ~0.81 tokens/ms; p99 improved from 124ms -> 96ms under the synthetic spike. Ran with:
```
bench/kvmicro --model redwood-v1 --seq 1024 --concurrency 8 --prefetch 600
```
CI-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout completed on pool-7 — 5 instances updated. Note: 3 instances OOM'd during the first wave but auto-restarted; logs attached in build 5821.
Priya: Action items for today: 1) I'll repro the p99 spike with a synthetic multi-client stress (spike profile attached), 2) collect jaeger traces and heap profiles, 3) open an observability alert if prefetch queue depth > 400 for > 30s.
Priya: Also please review #523 and #524 (batching slot-steal tweak) if you have cycles.
Alex: @Priya — I'll review both after standup, might also try running the stress profile on canary.
Sam: FYI on batching: slot-steal change reduces idle slot hold time, but I want to run microbench with mixed short/long sequences. Scheduling microbench at 13:00 PT and will paste results here.
Jon: No blockers from me, finishing the latency-regression repro for kv-evict tests.
Dana: I'll greenlight the observability alert once Priya posts the trace showing the threshold.
Priya: Thanks all — tagging this thread for async follow-ups. :thumbsup:
